interaction: Filter today's 24 flavours (dairy-free, vegan, nut-free), then spin a friction-physics wheel of the matching flavours with the Spin button, Space/Enter, a tap or a flick; the result is announced and can be dropped into a wobbling cone or cup builder of up to three scoops that shows the size and sample price.
notes: Nothing can be ordered: the cake request form ends in a demo toast and the cone card says to show it at the counter. Open/closed status and the earliest cake pick-up date use Melbourne time.
